نتمضمض (form IIq)
# نَتَمَضْمَضُ (natamaḍmaḍu) /na.ta.madˤ.ma.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# نَتَمَضْمَضَ (natamaḍmaḍa) /na.ta.madˤ.ma.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# نَتَمَضْمَضْ (natamaḍmaḍ) /na.ta.madˤ.madˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
